ex.en: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
ex.zh: 我們往車裡裝了很多行李。

ex.en: The man is loading the moving truck on his own.
ex.zh: 那個男人自己一個人把東西搬上搬家卡車。

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車最大載重量是 5 噸。

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.zh: 貨車的載貨量超過三噸。

ex.en: The website still loads.
ex.zh: 網站還在載入中。

ex.en: The page takes a long time to load.
ex.zh: 這個網頁載入要很久。

ex.en: The company uses a logistics partner to deliver its products.
ex.zh: 公司透過物流夥伴配送產品。

ex.en: She works in logistics for a shipping company.
ex.zh: 她在一家航運公司做物流。

ex.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.
ex.zh: 外行人談戰略，內行人談後勤。

ex.en: We need to plan the logistics of the conference.
ex.zh: 我們需要規劃研討會的後勤安排。

ex.en: You can withdraw money from ATMs that have the "UnionPay" logo.
ex.zh: 你可以在有「銀聯」標誌的提款機領錢。

ex.en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
ex.zh: 側邊欄顯示在網站標誌下方的頁面邊緣。

ex.en: The company rewards customer loyalty with discounts.
ex.zh: 公司用折扣回饋忠實顧客。

ex.en: His loyalty to his friends is admirable.
ex.zh: 他對朋友的忠誠令人欽佩。

ex.en: You can get a loan from a bank.
ex.zh: 你可以從銀行貸款。

ex.en: Interest on loans is high at present.
ex.zh: 目前的貸款利率很高。

ex.en: I do not need a loan anymore.
ex.zh: 我不需要貸款了。

ex.en: Tom asked Mary to loan him some money.
ex.zh: 湯姆問瑪麗能不能借他一些錢。

ex.en: Could you loan me your car for the weekend?
ex.zh: 週末可以把車借我嗎？

ex.en: Their losses reached one million yen.
ex.zh: 他們的損失達到一百萬日圓。

ex.en: The company suffered big losses.
ex.zh: 公司遭受了巨大的損失。

ex.en: His death was a great loss to our firm.
ex.zh: 他的過世對我們公司是一大損失。

ex.en: I was at a loss as to what to say.
ex.zh: 我不知道該說什麼。

ex.en: Tom was at a loss how to express himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆不知道該怎麼表達自己。

ex.en: I think we're lost. Let's ask someone.
ex.zh: 我想我們迷路了，找個人問問吧。

ex.en: She got lost in the old town.
ex.zh: 她在老城區迷路了。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這支筆跟我昨天弄丟的那支一樣。

ex.en: I finally found my lost keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我終於在沙發底下找到弄丟的鑰匙。

ex.en: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
ex.zh: 近幾年，很多當地的傳統都衰敗了。

ex.en: Tom took part in a local bike race.
ex.zh: 湯姆參加了當地的一場自行車比賽。

ex.en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
ex.zh: 馬克賣的羊奶在當地人中很受歡迎。

ex.en: The locals call this river the man-eating river and fear it.
ex.zh: 當地人把這條河叫做「吃人河」，對它很畏懼。

ex.en: I lost my wallet on the train.
ex.zh: 我在火車上把錢包弄丟了。

ex.en: Don't lose your boarding pass.
ex.zh: 別把登機證弄丟了。

ex.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
ex.zh: 100萬人在戰爭中失去了生命。

ex.en: We were in danger of losing our lives.
ex.zh: 我們差點喪命。

ex.en: Our team lost the game by two points.
ex.zh: 我們隊以兩分之差輸了比賽。

ex.en: I hate losing at cards.
ex.zh: 我很討厭打牌輸。

ex.en: I want to know how I can lose weight.
ex.zh: 我想知道要怎麼減重。

ex.en: She lost a lot of weight after she started running.
ex.zh: 她開始跑步之後瘦了很多。

ex.en: Where is the nearest lost and found?
ex.zh: 離這裡最近的失物招領處在哪裡？

ex.en: Where is the lost and found?
ex.zh: 失物招領處在哪兒？
